1.e4 c5 2.b3 d5 3.Bb2.strategy: Ignores the tension and develops, offering e4 for rapid development and an open long diagonal pointing at g7. White has to show that this is enough for the pawn, since the simple exchange on d5 is the more solid way to proceed.
1.e4 c5 2.b3 d5 3.Bb2.name: Sicilian Defence: Euwe Attack, Prins Gambit
